metadata.title: Jacobi fields and Jacobi sections for semisprays on Lie algebroids: transverse variations and equivalences
metadata.abstract: We study the relationship between Jacobi sections and Jacobi fields associated with semisprays on Lie algebroids. First, we characterize compatible transverse variations in terms of Lie algebroid morphisms. This characterization leads to a variational description of Jacobi sections: a section along an integral curve of a semispray is a Jacobi section if and only if it arises as the infinitesimal variation of a compatible transverse variation of a dynamical variation satisfying a suitable condition on its image in the base. We also investigate the relationship between Jacobi sections and Jacobi fields through the anchor map. We prove that every Jacobi section projects to a Jacobi field, and establish a converse when the corresponding base variation is contained in a single leaf of the characteristic foliation.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究Lie代数胚上半喷流的Jacobi截面与Jacobi场。用代数胚态射刻画相容横向变分，进而在底空间像满足适当条件时，将Jacobi截面刻画为相应变分的无穷小量。每个Jacobi截面经锚映射投影为Jacobi场，逆向在底变分落入特征叶状结构同一叶片时成立。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确Jacobi截面的变分来源及提升Jacobi场所需的叶片条件。
analysis.limitations: 逆向需要单叶片条件，其他变分像条件未在摘要中具体展开。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
